I'm sorry for the confusion. The other agent was wrong. Lumen doesn't have a 60-day refund window.

Annual plans can be refunded within 14 days of purchase. At 20 days, your purchase falls outside that window, so I can't offer a refund under our policy. I can't see your account, so if you think the date or the charge is off, email billing@lumen.io and they can check it.

You can also cancel at any time. You'd keep Pro access until the end of the annual period you've already paid for. If you'd like the billing team to review your situation anyway, email billing@lumen.io with your account email, the purchase date and amount, and your invoice number from Settings > Billing.
